subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-10-31 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: AI 泡沫担忧引发科技股暴跌，Anthropic 传将获垃圾评级
headline_en: AI bubble fears wipe $1tn off tech stocks; Anthropic reportedly faces junk rating

items.title_zh: AI 支出担忧引发科技股大跌，市值蒸发约 1 万亿美元
items.title_en: AI spending fears wipe roughly $1 trillion off tech stocks
items.body_zh: 受 AI 资本开支担忧拖累，华尔街科技股周四大幅下挫，纳斯达克开盘创两个多月新低，AI 相关股票市值合计蒸发约 1 万亿美元。英特尔股价继续下跌，美国政府持股价值缩水约 120 亿美元。
items.body_en: Wall Street tech stocks fell sharply as fears over AI capital spending deepened, with the Nasdaq opening at its lowest in more than two months and about $1 trillion wiped from AI-linked shares. Intel kept sliding, cutting roughly $12 billion from the value of the US government's stake.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 传 IPO 后将获高收益垃圾级评级
items.title_en: Anthropic reportedly expected to get high-yield junk rating after IPO
items.body_zh: 据 FT 报道，信用评级机构预计在 Anthropic IPO 后给予其较高的垃圾级评级。若成真，Anthropic 为支撑巨额支出而融资的成本和难度都会上升。
items.body_en: Credit agencies are expected to assign Anthropic a high junk rating after its IPO, the FT reported. If so, raising money to fund its heavy spending would become harder and more expensive.

items.title_zh: OpenAI、谷歌、微软、Anthropic 联手推 AI 抓取退出新标准
items.title_en: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic back new AI scraping opt-out standard
items.body_zh: 四家 AI 巨头表示将采纳一项新标准，出版商可一次性向多家公司表达“不要用我的内容训练 AI”的偏好，而不必逐家设置。这给内容方提供了一个统一的技术出口。
items.body_en: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that lets publishers set AI training opt-outs across multiple companies at once instead of one by one. It gives content owners a single technical channel for refusal.

items.title_zh: 苹果智能随 iOS 27.3 登陆中国，11 月 4 日推测试版
items.title_en: Apple Intelligence comes to China with iOS 27.3, beta on November 4
items.body_zh: 苹果在中国官网宣布，Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 进入中国市场，测试版 11 月 4 日上线，正式版 12 月发布。这是苹果 AI 功能首次在中国落地。
items.body_en: Apple said on its Chinese newsroom that Apple Intelligence will arrive in China with iOS 27.3, with a beta on November 4 and the full release in December. It marks the first China rollout of Apple's AI features.

items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 卫星首次从太空回传模型输出
items.title_en: Google's AI satellite sends first model output from space
items.body_zh: 谷歌称已成功启动卫星上的 TPU，让板载 Gemma 4 模型按提示生成了一首关于太空的俳句并回传地球。这是把 AI 算力放到轨道上的一次公开验证。
items.body_en: Google said it booted up the TPUs on its satellite, letting the onboard Gemma 4 model produce a haiku about space and transmit it back to Earth. It is a public test of putting AI compute in orbit.

items.title_zh: Salesforce 传以 3.75 亿美元收购国防科技公司 Rune
items.title_en: Salesforce reportedly to buy defense tech startup Rune for $375M
items.body_zh: 据报道，Salesforce 将以 3.75 亿美元收购 AI 物流初创公司 Rune，用于加强其 Missionforce 国防平台。这是 Salesforce 近期一系列并购中的最新一笔。
items.body_en: Salesforce is reported to be paying $375 million for Rune, an AI logistics startup, to bolster its Missionforce defense platform. It is the latest in a string of acquisitions by the CRM giant.

items.title_zh: 联发科确认第二家 AI ASIC 大客户，2028 年量产
items.title_en: MediaTek confirms second AI ASIC customer, mass production in 2028
items.body_zh: 联发科在财报电话会上确认拿下第二家 AI 专用芯片客户，预计 2028 年量产并贡献营收，并澄清该客户并非中国公司。其第一家客户是谷歌，首款数据中心 AI 加速器已于 9 月小量出货。
items.body_en: MediaTek confirmed on its earnings call a second AI ASIC customer, with mass production and revenue expected in 2028, and said the client is not a Chinese company. Its first customer is Google, and its first data-center AI accelerator began small-volume shipments in September.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 Cursor 扩展被植入后门近 12 小时
items.title_en: Anthropic VS Code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
items.body_zh: 攻击者通过 Anthropic 在 Cursor 上的已验证账号植入后门，持续近 12 小时，入侵途径尚不清楚。这暴露了 AI 编程工具供应链的薄弱环节。
items.body_en: Attackers backdoored Anthropic's verified Cursor account for nearly 12 hours, and how they got in is still unknown. The incident highlights weak links in the AI coding tool supply chain.

items.title_zh: 美国批准向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者导弹
items.title_en: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.body_zh: 美国批准向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者拦截弹，这是目前唯一能有效拦截俄罗斯弹道导弹的武器。此举将补充乌方防空弹药库存。
items.body_en: The US approved the sale of 500 Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine, the only weapon seen as effective against Russian ballistic missiles. The deal would replenish Kyiv's air-defense stockpile.

items.title_zh: 币安遭黑客攻击损失 63 亿美元，疑与朝鲜有关
items.title_en: Binance hit by $6.3bn hack, linked to North Korea
items.body_zh: 币安表示正在追回一起复杂网络攻击中被盗的 63 亿美元，据信这是史上最大规模的黑客事件。报道称攻击与朝鲜有关。
items.body_en: Binance said it is trying to recover $6.3 billion stolen in a complex cyberattack believed to be the largest hack ever. Reports link the attack to North Korea.

items.title_zh: 加拿大与欧盟宣布成立“未来联盟”，向志同道合国家开放
items.title_en: Canada and EU launch Alliance for the Future, open to like-minded nations
items.body_zh: 加拿大与欧盟在蒙特利尔峰会上宣布成立“未来联盟”，称其为“公民得以繁荣的保护伞”，并作为对不可预测世界的对冲。该联盟向其他志同道合国家开放。
items.body_en: Canada and the EU unveiled an Alliance for the Future at a Montreal summit, describing it as a protective canopy for citizens and a hedge against an unpredictable world. The alliance is open to other like-minded countries.

items.title_zh: 波兰最高法院控制权之争升级，警方进驻
items.title_en: Poland top court standoff escalates as police deployed
items.body_zh: 波兰政府暂停两名高级法官职务并拟提起刑事指控后，警方被部署到最高法院。总统纳夫罗茨基中断塞内加尔行程回国，称这是“政变”。
items.body_en: Police were deployed to Poland's Supreme Court after the government suspended two senior judges and moved to bring criminal charges. President Nawrocki cut short a trip to Senegal and called it a coup.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯最后一家独立报纸在压力下停刊
items.title_en: Russia's last independent newspaper shuts down under pressure
items.body_zh: 《新报》在当局压力下停刊，其创办人称“他们扼杀了我们”。这家报纸过去三十年一直是俄罗斯最知名的独立媒体之一。
items.body_en: Novaya Gazeta is shutting down under pressure from authorities, with its founder saying "they strangled us." For three decades it was one of Russia's most prominent independent outlets.

quick_zh: 香港 HKGAI 的 AI 助手“港话通”上线 AI 音乐功能，可免费生成粤语歌。
全球最大规模 60 兆瓦液态空气储能项目在青海格尔木并网发电，设备国产化率 100%。
AI 电影上映一周票房不到 150 万元，院线表现惨淡。
quick_en: Hong Kong's HKGAI added AI music generation to its HKChat assistant, free for Cantonese songs.
The world's largest 60MW liquid-air energy storage project was connected to the grid in Golmud, Qinghai, with 100% domestically made equipment.
An AI-made film took in under 1.5 million yuan in its first week, a poor showing in cinemas.
